_note: Aesthetic treatments the atelier gives in the room, as opposed to the peptides a patient takes at home. A card can carry both. Cadence is what decides when the next one is due; `color` is how it reads on a calendar.
_cadence: everyDays is the usual gap. firstGaps overrides it for the opening sessions of a course — PRX is weekly four times and then monthly, so firstGaps is [7,7,7] and everyDays is 30. courseOf ends a course rather than repeating forever. windowDays is a range where one exists, and the due date is taken from its start so the reminder lands at the beginning of the window rather than the end.
